name: les natures
roots: nature (natura, nasci); mode d'être (a way of being)

name: corps
roots: corps (corpus); étendue (extension: Descartes' res extensa, the body's whole essence)

name: le dicible
roots: dire (dicere); l'exprimable (Bréhier's rendering of the Stoic λεκτόν)

name: cadre
roots: quadrus (square): the frame of a picture

name: juste milieu
roots: le juste milieu (the mean); tempérament (temperamentum: the right mixing)

name: poids
roots: pensum (what is weighed out, from pendere, to hang, to weigh)

name: l'ordre des corps
roots: ordre (ordo); Pascal, Pensées (Lafuma 308): bodies, minds and charity — three orders, the third infinitely above the first

name: champ
roots: champ (campus: open land); the physicists' word: what fills space, its quanta the particles

name: noyau
roots: noyau (the stone of a fruit, from nux)

name: amour
roots: amor; charité (caritas: Pascal's third order, infinitely above bodies and minds)

name: sagesse
roots: sapere (to taste, to know): sage, the one who discerns the savour of things

name: par
roots: per (through); par l'entremise de (by the going-between of)

name: temps
roots: tempus (a stretch, a section — perhaps from the root of τέμνω, to cut)

name: vit dans
roots: habiter (habitare: to keep having, to dwell)

name: exposé des motifs
roots: motif (movere, to move: what moves a law)

name: examen
roots: examen (the tongue of a balance: to weigh)
